findings.source_quote:
Greetings of love in the name of Jesus, our Savior, our Redeemer, and our Lord. When our last magazine issue went out, most things in the world seemed to be continuing quite normally. Suddenly, everything started changing with unnerving speed and uncertainty. The next thing we knew a previously unheard-of virus had everyone’s attention. How our lives have changed.

Knowing this first,
